attributes.name: Lord Stillborn
attributes.powers:
Lord Stillborn is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

If undefeated, for each card you discard as damage, also discard the top card of your deck.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from; if you do, display Lord Stillborn next to your deck. At the start of your turn, summon and encounter Lord Stillborn, then banish him.
